static_traits.name: Zhang Yue
static_traits.family_status: Has two children, living in Chicago
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive spouse and close friends to talk to and seek help from
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problems before; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative, able to self-Reflect; steady tone but prone to irritability and disappointment when plans are disrupted; having cognitive tendencies of catastrophizing, mental filtering, jumping to conclusions, and black-and-white thinking

basic_info.main_problem: I feel the yoga class being canceled ruined my state for the whole week, leading to strong disappointment and frustration.
basic_info.core_demands: My emotional reactions may be disproportionate to the situation, which prompted me to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I cannot cope with change very well
Needs to keep strict control to maintain stability and relaxation

special_situations.event: That day's yoga class being canceled
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my self-care (yoga) is disrupted, my whole week will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to distract with other activities, but with limited effect

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Things must develop as I envision; otherwise it will be terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to avoid change, sticks to the original plan
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This should not happen; I cannot stand such change

special_situations.event: When considering replacing yoga with meditation or walking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it is not yoga, the effect will not be as good, possibly disappointing me again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers expectations before trying; hesitates about taking action
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They may not be as effective as yoga; I do not want to be disappointed again

special_situations.event: When reviewing this week's schedule and feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One plan setback equals the whole week failing; other positive parts do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly focuses on the negative, ignoring alternatives and positive factors

core_conflict.wish: Longs for stable, controllable self-care and order to gain safety and relaxation
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Emotional loss of control after losing control, the whole week sinking into chaos and low mood
defense_goal: Maintaining strict control over plans to lower Anxiety
Avoiding unpredictable changes to keep emotions stable

object_relations.self_representation: A self who needs control and is easily disrupted by change
object_relations.object_representation: The outside world and change are unpredictable disruptors

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to try alternative self-care activities (such as meditation, walking)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously worrying new activities cannot achieve the same effect as yoga, leading to disappointment again
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone, acknowledging their concerns; Guiding step-by-step attempts and setting realistic expectations; using concretizing Questioning, offering choices rather than forcing persuasion.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When realizing one's reactions may be disproportionate to the event and trying to examine them from a rational perspective (such as 'in the big picture this is just a yoga class')
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Distancing from emotions through rational analysis and abstraction, to reduce discomfort
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Affirms their self-awareness; gently invites them back to the body and present feelings; labels and concretizes emotions, avoiding excessive theorizing.

manifestations: Highly intolerant of plan changes, strongly needing control
Treating one cancellation as the whole week being ruined
Self-care highly dependent on a single activity (yoga)

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: An implicit sense of the rule 'things should go according to plan'
Finds change hard to tolerate, tends to stick to set arrangements

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Distracts with other activities when emotions are intense, but with limited effect
Avoiding direct contact with feelings of disappointment and frustration

exception_events.target_problem: When plans are disrupted, the client usually shows strong disappointment and emotional fluctuation, and finds it hard to carry out self-care activities.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the work scenario after the event, the client was not trapped by emotions as in daily self-care, but maintained focused and stable teaching performance, with work not yet affected.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different situations and structured work tasks helped maintain stability; also having a certain degree of self-awareness, able to identify reactions possibly being disproportionate.

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse and close friends
Having self-awareness, able to identify reactions possibly being disproportionate
Willing to try alternative activities and keep an open mind
negative_force: Low tolerance for change, strong need for control
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, and mental filtering
Self-care overly relies on a single activity (yoga)
Persistent disappointment and irritability affecting family interactions

target_behavior.behavior: When plans are disrupted (such as a yoga class being cancelled), showing catastrophizing and marked irritability
target_behavior.core_reason: Intolerance of change and strong need for control; having Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, and mental filtering.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and loss of control, trying to Reinforce control and importance through intense emotional reactions.
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood all week, irritable toward family, and self-care activities are hindered.

target_behavior.behavior: Uses distraction as the main strategy; avoids directly handling disappointment
antecedent: Disappointment and frustration after plan changes
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about being disappointed again; lacks alternative self-care strategies and emotion regulation methods.
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent disappointment, the problem not yet relieved.
